title: Evaluating Gender, Racial, and Age Biases in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis of Occupational and Crime Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Generating 500-word stories using open-ended prompts about different professions and crime scenarios, automatically classifying the gender of the subjects using LLMs, and comparing the resulting gender distributions against real-world demographic data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) and the FBI.

Generating 500-word stories about various crime scenarios, automatically classifying the race of the individuals involved using LLMs, and comparing the generated racial distributions against real-world arrest demographics from US FBI reports.

Generating 500-word stories about different crime scenarios, using LLMs to categorize the age of the individuals involved into specific age brackets (Below 18, 18-30, 31-50, Above 50), and benchmarking the age distribution against real-world US FBI statistics.
